parameters.name: ArbiterVSwitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch ID of the arbitration node.

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the multi-zone cluster.

parameters.name: CoreNodeCount
parameters.description: The number of core nodes. The minimum value is 4, and the increment must be a multiple of 2.

parameters.name: LogNodeCount
parameters.description: The number of log nodes. The minimum value is 4, and the value must be a multiple of 4.

parameters.name: PrimaryCoreNodeCount
parameters.description: The number of core nodes in the primary zone instance. The minimum value is 4, and the increment must be a multiple of 2.

parameters.name: PrimaryVSwitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch ID of the instance in the primary zone.

parameters.name: StandbyCoreNodeCount
parameters.description: The number of core nodes in the secondary zone instance. The minimum value is 4, and the increment must be a multiple of 2.

parameters.name: StandbyVSwitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch ID of the instance in the secondary zone.
